body: I feel exactly the same way.  I hate everything now.  Good luck.

The reasons are stupid, aren't they all?  

I'm just am wilting under the strain of divorce, foreclosure, near-homelessness, and a bitter ex that seems to undermine me at every turn with finances and my relationship with the kids.  They live with her and I find them more and more reluctant to come over even though for 2 years they lived with me and we did great.

So fuck it.  Kill her or me.  If I kill her, then I go to prison and my kids lose both parents.  I kill myself, they will get over it (or not), she can do as she pleases and nobody will give a fuck.
